headquarters.working_hours: Monday to Friday: 09:30 AM – 06:00 PM (Public grievances: 10:00 AM – 01:00 PM)

faq_topics.question: How do I file a new grievance or civic complaint with NDMC?
faq_topics.answer: You can file a complaint in 3 easy ways: 1) Use the NDMC 311 Mobile App, 2) Submit via the online citizen portal (ndmc.gov.in) with AI auto-categorization, or 3) Call the 24x7 toll-free helpline 1533. You will receive an instant 10-digit tracking number via SMS.

faq_topics.question: How can I track the status of my existing grievance?
faq_topics.answer: To track your grievance, enter your 10-digit Complaint ID (e.g., NDMC-2026-XXXX) on the Track Status page or text 'STATUS <ComplaintID>' to 1533. Our system shows live progress, assigned field officer, and SLA resolution timeline.

faq_topics.question: What are the standard SLA resolution timelines for NDMC complaints?
faq_topics.answer:
Standard NDMC Citizen Charter resolution timelines: 
- Critical / Safety Hazards (Live wire, open manhole, toxic spill): 4 to 12 Hours
- Electricity Outage / Street Lights / Sanitation: 24 Hours
- Water Supply / Road Potholes / Stray Cattle: 24 to 48 Hours
- Illegal Construction / Property Tax Disputes / Civil works: 72 Hours to 7 Days.

faq_topics.question: What should I do if my complaint is not resolved within the SLA timeframe?
faq_topics.answer:
If an issue is not resolved within SLA, it automatically escalates:
- Level 1: Junior Engineer / Sanitary Inspector (0 - SLA)
- Level 2: Executive Engineer / Chief Medical Officer (SLA + 24 hrs)
- Level 3: Superintending Engineer / Director (SLA + 48 hrs)
- Level 4: Secretary / Chairman NDMC (Public Hearing every Wednesday 10 AM – 12 PM at Palika Kendra).

faq_topics.question: How can I request an emergency water tanker in NDMC area?
faq_topics.answer: Emergency water tankers can be booked free of cost during pipeline disruptions by calling 011-23360683 or 1533, or lodging a 'Water Tanker Request' on the portal with your exact ward and house address. Tankers are typically dispatched within 2 hours.

faq_topics.question: How do I pay property tax and get tax receipts?
faq_topics.answer: Visit ndmc.gov.in -> Online Services -> Property Tax. Enter your 10-digit Property ID or Property UPIC. Payments are accepted via UPI, NetBanking, Debit/Credit Card. Instant digital signed receipts (Form G-8) are downloadable immediately upon payment.

faq_topics.question: How do I report a dark spot or faulty street light pole?
faq_topics.answer: Report faulty streetlights by noting the 6-digit Pole Number painted on the lamp post. Submit a complaint under 'Street Lighting' on the NDMC portal or 311 App with pole number & landmark. Field electrical teams attend to dark spots within 24 hours.

faq_topics.question: How to report aggressive stray dogs or request animal birth control / sterilization?
faq_topics.answer: Call the NDMC Veterinary Control Room at 011-23365347 or lodge a grievance under 'Veterinary & Stray Animal Control'. The NDMC animal van will capture the dog for sterilization, anti-rabies vaccination (ABC program), and release back as per Animal Birth Control Rules 2023.
